example: The council proposed turning the empty warehouse into flats, but engineers warned that the roof needed repairs first. (市議會提議把空倉庫改成住宅，但工程師警告屋頂必須先修繕。)
She needed an operation on her knee and stayed in hospital for four days. (她的膝蓋需要動手術，因此住院四天。)
The supply chain suddenly broke down, so local shops ran out of essential goods within two days. (供應鏈突然中斷，當地商店兩天內就賣光基本必需品。)
Her job application was very strong, yet the panel finally chose someone with considerably more relevant practical experience. (她的求職申請很出色，但評審最後選了具備更多相關實務經驗的人。)
The rail network is being upgraded to cope with rising passenger numbers. (鐵路網正在升級，以因應不斷增加的乘客量。)
The company needs a clear strategy for reducing its dependence on coal. (公司需要明確的策略來減少對煤炭的依賴。)
A degree in economics is no longer a guarantee of a well-paid job. (經濟學學位已不再是高薪工作的保證。)
The author spent five years interviewing families affected by the factory closure. (作者花了五年訪問受工廠關閉影響的家庭。)
The pressure at work suddenly increased again, so she eventually asked for two weeks of much-needed unpaid leave. (工作壓力又突然增加，因此她最後申請了兩週亟需的無薪假。)
Fierce competition at the flower show pushed gardeners to breed increasingly unusual roses, fascinating visitors. (花展的激烈競爭促使園藝家培育越來越奇特的玫瑰，讓參觀者著迷。)

meaning: n. 推薦信；推薦人評語
example: Landlords often ask for a written reference from a previous landlord, which makes moving to the city difficult for newcomers. (房東常要求提供前任房東的書面推薦，讓初來城市的人很難搬進城裡。)
The argument's conclusion was clear, yet the supporting evidence remained surprisingly weak. (論證的結論很清楚，但支持它的證據仍出乎意料地薄弱。)
Family doctors now recommend natural remedies only when scientific evidence shows that they are truly safe and effective. (家庭醫師現在只有在科學證據顯示自然療法真正安全有效時，才會建議使用。)
The demand for evening classes went beyond what the college had expected, forcing it to hire more tutors. (夜間課程的需求超出學院的預期，迫使學院聘請更多教師。)
The report defines poverty in terms of income, health and adequate housing. (這份報告從收入、健康和適足住房來界定貧窮。)
Local rents are reviewed on a yearly basis, which gives tenants little protection when prices often rise suddenly. (當地租金每年檢討一次，這讓房客在價格突然上漲時幾乎沒有保障。)
Solar energy now powers thousands of homes and small businesses in the region. (太陽能現在為該地區數千戶家庭和小型企業供電。)
The new report refers to rapidly falling birth rates but says little about how local schools should respond. (這份新報告提到生育率快速下降，卻很少談到地方學校該如何因應。)
The early trial produced unexpectedly positive results, though doctors still remain cautious because the sample was very small. (早期試驗出現意外正面的結果，不過醫師仍保持謹慎，因為樣本數非常少。)
The disease spread quickly through the crowded camp before clean water arrived. (乾淨的水送達前，這種疾病在擁擠的營地裡迅速傳播。)
Property prices near the new station have risen much faster than local wages. (新車站附近的房地產價格，漲幅遠超過當地薪資。)
The plant operates around the clock to meet demand for bottled water. (這座工廠全天候運轉，以滿足瓶裝水的需求。)
The bus company made a profit last year, but it still plans to raise fares and cut rural routes. (這家公車公司去年有獲利，卻仍計畫調漲票價並裁減鄉村路線。)
Tickets must be booked well in advance, especially during the summer holidays. (尤其是在暑假期間，票一定要提早預訂。)
People tend to overestimate how quickly they can finish a task, which causes unnecessary stress and missed deadlines. (人們往往高估自己完成任務的速度，這造成不必要的壓力和錯過的期限。)
Doctors often assume that patients regularly take their medicine as prescribed, yet studies show that many simply forget. (醫師常假定病人會按指示規律服藥，但研究顯示許多人只是忘了吃。)
Returning to normal working hours helped him sleep better, although he still felt tired for the first week. (恢復正常工作時間後，他睡得比較好，儘管第一週仍覺得疲倦。)

meaning: v. 受損；遭受不利影響
example: Local shops suffer badly when roadworks block the narrow pavement, even if the work eventually brings more customers. (路面施工擋住狹窄人行道時，當地店家生意大受影響，即使工程最終會帶來更多顧客。)
The two universities exchange teaching materials and run a joint summer programme. (這兩所大學交流教材，並合辦暑期課程。)
The still lake reflects the snowy mountains so clearly that it looks like a giant mirror. (平靜的湖面清晰映出雪山，看起來就像一面巨大的鏡子。)
The strongest argument for change is simply cost, since the old system wastes both money and staff time. (支持改變最有力的理由就是成本，因為舊制度既浪費金錢也浪費員工時間。)

meaning: n. 資源；可運用的條件
example: Time is a limited resource in every classroom, so teachers must decide which activities deserve the most attention. (時間是每個教室裡有限的資源，因此教師必須決定哪些活動最值得投入。)
The new sports facility is open to all local residents at weekends. (新的運動設施週末開放給所有本地居民使用。)
Parliament will debate the new housing bill for two days before voting on it. (國會將針對新住宅法案辯論兩天，然後進行表決。)
Please separate the glass bottles from the paper before putting them outside. (請把玻璃瓶和紙張分開，再放到外面。)
Each candidate was asked to explain clearly how their previous experience would help them handle the demanding role. (每位求職者都被要求清楚說明，他們先前的經驗會如何幫助他們勝任這份要求很高的工作。)
The villagers struggle to maintain the old bridge, as repair costs rise sharply every year. (村民努力維護這座老橋，因為修繕費每年都急劇上升。)
She took a two-year career break, returning to full-time nursing at the local hospital when her children started primary school. (她暫停職涯兩年，等孩子上小學後回到當地醫院擔任全職護理工作。)
The government plans to spend two billion dollars on new railway lines. (政府計畫在新建鐵路線上花費二十億美元。)
Her previous job was far more stressful, although it still paid much better than her current one. (她以前的工作壓力大得多，儘管薪水仍比現在這份好很多。)
Her calm manner is a great asset when customers start to complain. (客人開始抱怨時，她沉穩的態度是一大優勢。)
The orchestra will perform in the park on Sunday, provided the weather remains dry and the wind stays calm. (只要天氣保持乾燥、風勢平穩，樂團星期天將在公園演出。)
Keeping a strict balance between full-time study and part-time work proved much harder than she had originally expected. (在全職學業與打工之間維持嚴格的平衡，比她原先預期的還要難得多。)
Free fruit in schools encourages children to try new foods, although habits at home matter just as much. (學校提供免費水果能鼓勵孩子嘗試新食物，不過家裡的飲食習慣同樣重要。)
Coastal wetlands protect the land from serious flooding during severe winter storms. (沿海濕地在強烈冬季風暴期間保護陸地免於嚴重水患。)
The scandal caused lasting damage to the company's reputation, frightening away several major investors. (這起醜聞對公司名譽造成長久損害，嚇跑好幾位主要投資人。)
Engineers estimate the final renovation will cost far more than the council originally promised voters. (工程師估計最後的整修費用將遠高於地方議會原先向選民承諾的金額。)
The remark sounded rude, but in context it was clearly meant as a joke. (那句話聽起來很無禮，但從上下文來看，顯然只是玩笑。)
Much of the credit for the discovery belongs to a young researcher who noticed a faint pattern in the data. (這項發現的大部分功勞歸於一位年輕研究員，他注意到數據中一個微弱的規律。)
The latest version of the software fixes several bugs but also removes a popular feature. (最新版軟體修正了幾個錯誤，但也移除了一項受歡迎的功能。)
The festival offers a variety of performances, from street acrobatics to quiet readings in the small local library. (這個節慶提供各式各樣的表演，從街頭特技到當地小圖書館裡的靜態朗讀都有。)
She applied to extend her student visa, but the office officially warned that processing could take several weeks. (她申請延長學生簽證，但辦事處正式警告處理可能需要好幾週。)
The proposal for a new car park was rejected at the public meeting. (新停車場的提案在公開會議上被否決了。)
They hired a professional photographer for the wedding, although a talented friend offered to do it all for free. (他們請了專業攝影師拍婚禮，儘管一位有才華的朋友主動表示願意免費包辦。)
The nurses' request for extra night staff was finally approved, though the change will only start next month. (護理師要求增加夜班人力的申請終於獲准，不過這項改變下個月才開始。)
The original plan was much simpler, but several unnecessary late changes made the whole project far more expensive. (最初的計畫簡單得多，但幾項不必要的後期變更讓整個專案貴了許多。)
Scientists observe the birds from a hidden hut to avoid affecting their behaviour. (科學家從隱蔽的小屋觀察鳥類，以免影響牠們的行為。)
The school informed all parents about the sudden closure, sending messages quickly enough for them to arrange childcare. (學校通知所有家長停課消息，訊息送得夠快，讓他們能安排托育。)
Researchers discovered that the common drug works better when taken in the morning, contrary to widely accepted earlier advice. (研究人員發現這種常見藥物在早上服用效果更好，與先前廣被接受的建議相反。)
The travel agency arranged everything, from flights to insurance, yet it actually forgot to confirm the hotel booking. (旅行社安排好一切，從機票到保險，卻竟然忘了確認飯店訂房。)
Doctors examined the small X-ray carefully but found no fracture, so they simply advised rest instead of surgery. (醫師仔細查看這張小型 X 光片，但沒發現骨折，因此只建議休息，不必動手術。)
Tenants should seek independent legal advice before signing a lease, especially if the terms seem very unusual. (房客在簽租約前應尋求獨立的法律建議，尤其是條款看起來很不尋常時。)
The university has opened a new campus to accommodate growing student numbers. (這所大學啟用新校區，以容納不斷增加的學生人數。)
I recommend the small bakery near the bridge for its warm rye bread. (我推薦橋邊那家小麵包店，它的黑麥麵包是溫熱的。)
Caring for the river is a shared responsibility, so farmers and factories must both reduce their polluting waste. (照顧這條河是共同責任，因此農民和工廠都必須減少污染性廢棄物。)

meaning: adj. 獨立的；不受控制的
example: The study was funded by a charity, which allowed the researchers to remain completely independent of industry pressure. (這項研究由慈善機構資助，讓研究人員得以完全獨立於產業壓力。)
The school needs additional funding for new books, yet the council has frozen its budget for three years. (學校需要額外經費買新書，但市議會已凍結預算三年。)
The estate agent showed us four apartments before we chose the smaller one. (房仲帶我們看了四間公寓，我們才選了較小的那一間。)
The machine looks complex, yet most faults can be fixed with a simple screwdriver and a little patience. (這台機器看起來很複雜，但多數故障用一把簡單螺絲起子和一點耐心就能修好。)
It is not appropriate to prescribe antibiotics for every cough, since most infections simply clear up without them. (每個咳嗽都開抗生素並不適當，因為大多數感染不用藥就會自行痊癒。)

meaning: adj. 傳統的；沿襲習俗的
example: Although the town now attracts thousands of tourists, its traditional houses are still occupied by local families who refuse to sell. (這座小鎮現在吸引數千名遊客，傳統房屋仍由不願出售的當地家庭居住。)
She did not reply to the email until the following Monday morning. (她一直到隔週一早上才回覆那封電子郵件。)
The new software automatically checks long documents for spelling and grammar errors. (新軟體會自動檢查文件中的拼字和文法錯誤。)
The new rice variety performed well in repeated field trials, producing more grain with noticeably less water and fertiliser. (新品種稻米在反覆的田間試驗中表現良好，用明顯較少的水和肥料生產更多穀物。)

meaning: n. 行政單位；管理部門
example: The university administration promised to answer every application within ten days, but many students still waited much longer. (大學行政單位承諾十天內回覆每份申請，但許多學生仍等了更久。)
A surprise element is essential to any truly good ghost story, keeping readers uncertain until the final page. (意外要素對任何真正精彩的鬼故事都不可或缺，能讓讀者不確定到最後一頁。)
The judge will announce the final winner at noon, and the prize will be publicly presented immediately afterwards. (評審將在中午宣布最終優勝者，獎項隨後立即公開頒發。)
A new medical certificate is now a requirement for every single applicant, which has slowed the process considerably. (新的醫療證明現在是每位申請人的必要條件，這讓流程慢了不少。)
Small class sizes are genuinely effective only when teachers receive regular professional training and adequate planning support each term. (小班制唯有在教師獲得定期專業訓練和足夠備課支援時，才真正有效。)
The staff survey clearly revealed low morale, so managers promised to review workloads before the end of term. (員工調查清楚顯示士氣低落，因此主管承諾在學期結束前檢討工作量。)
Governments that invest in public early education often save considerable money later on healthcare and crime, according to economists. (經濟學家指出，投資公共幼兒教育的政府，日後往往能在醫療和犯罪防治上省下可觀經費。)
The majority of members supported the plan, yet the chair insisted on holding another formal vote next month. (多數成員支持這項計畫，但主席堅持下個月再舉行一次正式表決。)
Tourism is now the primary source of income for the whole island. (觀光現在是整座島的主要收入來源。)
The younger generation now spends far more time online than their parents did at the same age. (年輕一代現在上網的時間，遠比他們的父母在同年紀時多得多。)

meaning: adj. 聯邦的；聯邦政府的
example: Federal funding paid for the new road, but the town maintains it. (新路是用聯邦經費蓋的，但由鎮公所維護。)
Robots may replace routine factory jobs, but they also create new roles that increasingly demand different technical skills. (機器人可能取代例行的工廠工作，但也創造出越來越需要不同技術能力的新職務。)
Serious exam stress often disrupts students' sleep, which can make concentration even harder the following week. (嚴重的考試壓力常打亂學生睡眠，使他們在接下來一週更難專心。)
The club committee voted to rebuild the old changing rooms, but postponed a decision on raising membership fees. (俱樂部委員會表決重建老舊更衣室，但延後決定是否調漲會員費。)
The design follows the principle that natural light should reach every room. (這項設計遵循讓自然光照進每個房間的原則。)
The website content was outdated, so the team rewrote every page before the launch. (網站內容已過時，因此團隊在上線前重寫了每一頁。)
A growing percentage of graduates now work in jobs unrelated to their degree, according to a recent national survey. (根據最近一項全國調查，現在有越來越高比例的畢業生從事與所學無關的工作。)
The research laboratory bought new equipment for measuring local air and water quality. (研究實驗室採購了新設備，用來測量當地空氣與水質。)
The family kept to a strict holiday budget, cooking most meals themselves and avoiding expensive tourist restaurants. (這家人嚴格遵守度假預算，自己煮大多數餐點，並避開昂貴的觀光客餐廳。)
Employees can transfer to another department after a full year, provided they successfully complete the required internal training. (員工滿一年後可以轉調其他部門，前提是順利完成規定的內部訓練。)
The doctor's professional conduct was questioned after several patients complained about rude remarks during consultations. (幾位病人抱怨醫師在看診時出言無禮後，他的專業行為受到質疑。)
The health sector now employs more local people than the factories once did. (醫療產業現在雇用的人數，比過去的工廠還多。)
The annual check-up includes routine blood tests, a hearing check and a short conversation about diet and exercise. (年度健康檢查包括例行抽血、聽力檢查，以及簡短討論飲食與運動。)
Regular and careful hand washing helps prevent the spread of infection in crowded city hospitals. (規律且仔細洗手有助預防感染在擁擠的城市醫院中擴散。)
Monthly online payment is now standard, yet some older local customers still prefer to pay at the counter. (每月線上付款現在已是常態，但一些年長的當地顧客仍偏好到櫃檯付款。)
His carefully kept stamp collection filled twelve old albums, and it was finally donated to a small local museum. (他細心保存的郵票收藏裝滿十二本舊冊，最後捐給一家小型地方博物館。)
Her advice on saving money each month was practical, although it required far more discipline than he had expected. (她關於每月存錢的建議很實際，儘管這需要比他預期更多的自律。)
She entered local politics after years of working for a community organisation. (她在社區組織工作多年後踏入政治。)
Surgeons successfully removed the small tumour, and the anxious patient was able to go home two days later. (外科醫師成功切除小腫瘤，焦慮的病人兩天後就能回家。)
Staff check the equipment twice a day to ensure that patients are never left waiting. (工作人員每天檢查設備兩次，以確保病患不會一直空等。)
Medical students now spend more time in local clinics, which gives them valuable practical experience before they qualify. (醫學生現在花更多時間在當地診所，在取得資格前獲得寶貴的實務經驗。)

meaning: n. 交通運輸；交通工具
example: Public transport in the valley is limited to two buses a day. (這個山谷的大眾運輸一天只有兩班公車。)
The procedure for reporting an accident is posted on the wall of every workshop. (意外通報的程序張貼在每間工作坊的牆上。)
The contrast between the two gardens is striking in the early spring. (早春時，這兩座花園的對比非常明顯。)
There is a clear connection between city traffic pollution and childhood asthma. (城市交通汙染與兒童氣喘之間有明顯關聯。)
The old hospital became a research institution after the new one opened. (新醫院啟用後，舊醫院成了一所研究機構。)
The chef admitted that he had added too much salt, and offered every table a free dessert as an apology. (主廚承認自己鹽加太多，並免費招待每桌一份甜點作為道歉。)
Consumer confidence fell sharply after news of rising electricity prices quickly spread across the region. (電價上漲的消息在各地迅速傳開後，消費者信心大幅下滑。)
Satellite images revealed that the forest had shrunk dramatically, despite official claims that logging was under strict control. (衛星影像顯示森林大幅縮減，儘管官方聲稱伐木受到嚴格控制。)
We must leave by six, otherwise the heavy traffic will certainly make us late for the opening ceremony. (我們必須六點前出發，否則繁忙的交通一定會讓我們趕不上開幕典禮。)
Many drivers are not aware that idling engines waste fuel, so simple roadside signs could change their habits. (許多駕駛不知道怠速空轉會浪費燃油，因此簡單的路邊標示就能改變他們的習慣。)
The quiet coastal village appeals strongly to remote workers, who value fast internet and a slower daily pace. (這座安靜的海濱村莊強烈吸引遠距工作者，他們重視快速網路和較慢的日常步調。)

meaning: adj. 替代的；其他可選的
example: The island heavily invests in alternative energy, since importing fuel by ship remains very expensive and unreliable. (這座島大力投資替代能源，因為用船進口燃料仍非常昂貴且不可靠。)
The status of the building project changes every week as funding is reviewed. (隨著資金不斷檢討，這項建築計畫的狀況每週都在變。)
He received a local award for bravery, although he modestly insists he simply did what anyone would have done. (他因英勇行為獲得當地獎項，儘管他謙虛地堅稱自己只是做了任何人都會做的事。)
The surface of the moon is covered with fine dust, which forms a thick grey layer over the rock beneath. (月球表面覆蓋著細塵，在底下的岩石上形成厚厚的灰色層。)
She handles difficult customer complaints calmly, even when the callers are rude. (她能冷靜處理難纏的客訴，即使來電者態度無禮。)
The introduction clearly explains the author's main purpose, but it says little about the evidence actually behind her claims. (導言清楚說明作者的主要目的，但對其主張背後的實際證據著墨不多。)
She delivered her short speech without notes, which impressed the entire audience and quietly silenced the earlier criticism. (她沒看稿就發表了簡短演說，讓全場觀眾印象深刻，也悄悄平息了先前的批評。)
The council intends to ban cars from the square during the summer months. (市議會打算在夏季期間禁止車輛進入廣場。)
A decade of research has improved early treatment, yet many patients still wait months for a correct diagnosis. (十年的研究改善了早期治療，但許多病人仍要等好幾個月才能獲得正確診斷。)

meaning:

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: n. 議會；理事會；地方政府

meaning:
n. 部隊；軍隊；一群人
v. 成群結隊地走；集合

Doctors concluded that the illness was caused by contaminated water, not by the food served at the hotel. (醫師判定，這種疾病是受污染的水造成的，而不是飯店提供的食物。)

meaning:
n. 金融；財務；資金

meaning: n. 威脅；危害；威脅物；威脅來源

meaning: n. 工作室；攝影棚；單身套房

meaning: n. 安全；平安；安全裝置
example: Safety at the factory improved after new machines replaced the oldest equipment there. (廠內最老舊的設備換成新機器後，工廠的安全狀況改善了。)

meaning:
v. 出口；輸出
n. 出口品；輸出
example: The country exports heavy machinery to its neighbours, although domestic demand for those goods remains strong. (這個國家將重型機械出口到鄰國，儘管國內對這些產品的需求仍然強勁。)

meaning:

n. 週期；循環；自行車

The editor asked the journalist to check every fact before the article was published. (編輯要求記者在刊出文章前查證每一項事實。)
Scientists are developing new crops that can survive longer periods without rain. (科學家正在培育能在更長時間無雨的情況下存活的新作物。)

meaning:
n. 螢幕；監測器；班長

The film crew chose a coastal location because it offered dramatic light. (劇組選擇海岸邊的地點，因為那裡的光線很有戲劇效果。)

meaning: adj. 實際的；真實的；現行的

meaning: adj. 企業的；公司的；全體一致的

meaning:
n. 胚胎；初期階段

meaning:
n. 謀殺；殺人罪

meaning:
v. 登記；註冊；顯示
n. 登記簿；名冊；收銀機

The new regulation limits the amount of plastic packaging that shops may use. (新規定限制商店能使用的塑膠包裝數量。)

The film shows the terrible violence of war without ever glorifying it. (這部電影呈現戰爭的殘酷暴力，卻從未加以美化。)
The walking route crosses two open fields and a small wood, so good sturdy shoes are strongly recommended. (這條健行路線穿過兩片空曠田野和一小片樹林，因此強烈建議穿上結實好走的鞋。)

meaning: adj. 不可能的；難以忍受的
example: Finishing the whole report by Friday is really impossible unless two more colleagues join the small team immediately. (除非另外兩名同事立刻加入這個小團隊，否則週五前完成整份報告真的不可能。)

A small error in the calculation led to a much larger bill. (計算中的一個小錯誤，讓帳單金額高出許多。)
The accident at the factory led to a lengthy investigation into safety procedures. (工廠發生的事故引發了對安全程序的長期調查。)

meaning: adj. 艱難的；堅韌的；嚴格的

meaning:
prep. 在……對面
adj. 相反的；對面的
n. 相反的人或事；對立面

After a long shift, she likes to relax with a quiet hot bath and an old mystery novel. (長時間輪班後，她喜歡安靜地泡熱水澡、讀一本舊推理小說來放鬆。)

meaning:
n. 特徵；特色；特性
adj. 典型的；特有的
example: A long tail is a useful characteristic of this species, helping it balance in high branches. (長尾巴是這個物種的一項實用特徵，能幫助牠在高處的樹枝上保持平衡。)

The new flexible work arrangement lets staff start early, provided they still attend the daily morning meeting online. (新的彈性工作安排讓員工提早開始工作，前提是仍須每天線上參加晨會。)
Local fishermen oppose the plan because the new port would destroy their grounds. (新港口會破壞漁場，因此當地漁民反對這項計畫。)

meaning: adj. 相關的；切題的；適用的

meaning:
adj. 主要的；首要的

She easily used a phone app to locate her missing keys, which had apparently fallen behind the sofa. (她輕易地用手機應用程式找到不見的鑰匙；鑰匙似乎掉在沙發後面。)

meaning: adj. 國內的；家庭的；馴養的

The bank opened a new branch in the village, which saved elderly customers a long weekly bus trip. (銀行在村裡新設分行，讓年長客戶免去每週搭長途公車往返的麻煩。)

meaning: n. 車輛；交通工具；媒介
example: The vehicle was stopped by police because its brake lights were not working. (這輛車因煞車燈故障而遭警方攔下。)

meaning: adj. 公民的；民事的；文明有禮的

Medical students spend hours reading the latest literature on treatments for rare diseases. (醫學生花好幾個小時閱讀治療罕見疾病的最新文獻。)
Working from home gives her the freedom to arrange her day around her family. (在家工作讓她能自由地依照家人的作息安排一天。)

meaning:
v. 引用；報價；列舉
n. 引文；報價；行情

The stadium's capacity was reduced during major repairs, so thousands of fans simply watched the match at home. (體育場大規模整修期間，容納人數減少，因此數千名球迷只好在家看比賽。)

These old documents belong in the archive, not in the manager's office. (這些舊文件應該放在檔案室，而不是經理辦公室。)
Each participant was interviewed twice, and those who missed a session were later asked to explain their absence. (每位參加者都接受兩次訪談，缺席一場的人之後會被要求說明原因。)

meaning: n. 比較；對照；比較結果

A strong belief in local produce drew customers to her small shop. (她堅信本地農產品的價值，吸引顧客走進她的小店。)

meaning:
n. 代表；代理人；業務代表
adj. 典型的；代表性的
example: A senior union representative met the managers to discuss safety, but no final agreement was reached that afternoon. (工會的一位資深代表與主管會面討論安全問題，但當天下午未能達成最終協議。)

meaning:
n. 訊號；信號；徵兆
v. 發信號；示意；表明
example: The phone signal is weak inside the valley, so calls often fail. (山谷裡的手機訊號很弱，因此通話常常無法接通。)

meaning: adj. 技術的；專門的；工藝的

meaning: v. 否認；拒絕給予；不准

Residents were invited to participate in planning the new local park, and their suggestions shaped the final design. (居民受邀參與新公園的規劃，他們的建議也影響了最終設計。)

meaning:
n. 場合；時機；特殊事件
vt. 引起；造成
example: The memorable final was the only occasion this season when the home stadium was completely sold out well in advance. (這場令人難忘的決賽，是本季唯一提前很久就全數售罄的主場賽事。)

meaning: n. 領導；領導能力；領導階層

meaning:

n. 手機；活動式掛飾
example: Mobile phones must be switched off during examinations to prevent any possibility of cheating. (考試期間必須關閉手機，以避免任何作弊的可能。)

meaning:
n. 邊界；邊境；邊緣
v. 與……接壤；沿……設邊
example: The river still forms a natural unbroken border between the two countries for almost three hundred winding kilometres. (這條河至今仍是兩國之間天然且連續的邊界，蜿蜒將近三百公里。)

meaning:
vt. 標示；貼標籤；把……歸類
n. 標籤；標示；稱號
example: Parents must clearly label every item of clothing before their young children leave for summer camp. (年幼孩子出發去夏令營前，父母必須清楚標示每一件衣物。)

meaning:
v. 裝載；載入；使負重

meaning: adj. 適合的；合適的；相稱的
example: This soil is not suitable for growing rice because it drains too quickly. (這種土壤排水太快，不適合種植稻米。)

meaning: adj. 內部的；體內的；內心的
example: An internal review found that the delays were caused by poor planning. (內部檢討發現，延誤是由於規劃不周所造成。)

meaning: n. 事件；事務；風流韻事
example: The minister resigned after details of the affair appeared in the press. (這起事件的細節在媒體曝光後，那名部長辭職了。)
Nobody could predict the outcome of the vote until the last minute. (直到最後一刻，沒有人能預測投票結果。)

meaning:
n. 折扣；折價
vt. 打折；不予考慮；認為不可信
example: The garage offers a discount to older customers, which has brought them a steady stream of loyal business. (這家修車廠提供年長顧客折扣，因此穩定吸引許多熟客上門。)
The hikers ignored local advice about the weather and soon found themselves trapped by rising water. (健行者沒有理會當地人對天氣的提醒，很快就發現自己被上漲的河水困住。)

meaning:
v. 懷疑；猜想
n. 嫌疑犯；可疑人物
example: Investigators suspect that the fire started in an empty warehouse nearby last night. (調查人員懷疑，火災昨晚起於附近一座空倉庫。)
Every adult citizen has the right to vote and to receive a basic education. (每位成年公民都有投票和接受基礎教育的權利。)
The dictionary's definition of the term is clearer than the one in my textbook. (字典對這個詞的定義比課本上的版本更清楚。)
Inspectors will investigate why the water in the lake suddenly turned green. (檢查人員將調查湖水突然變成綠色的原因。)

meaning: adj. 熟悉的；常見的；親近的
example: Her voice sounded familiar, but I could not remember where we had met. (她的聲音聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起我們曾在哪裡見過。)

meaning:
n. 貸款；借款；借出物
vt. 借出；貸與

We explored narrow lanes in the oldest part of town for most of the afternoon. (我們花了大半個下午，探索城鎮最古老區域的狹窄巷弄。)

meaning:
n. 索引；指數；指標
v. 編索引；為……建立索引
example: The index at the back of the book helps readers find topics quickly. (書末的索引能幫助讀者快速找到相關主題。)
A strong recommendation from her previous supervisor helped her secure the full-time job, even though she lacked formal experience. (前任主管的大力推薦，幫助她取得這份全職工作，儘管她缺乏正式經驗。)

meaning:
n. 民意調查；投票；票數
v. 進行民調；獲得票數

meaning:
n. 逃脫；逃避；出口
v. 逃脫；逃避；漏出
example: Two prisoners escaped through a tunnel that they had dug over several long months. (兩名囚犯經由他們花了好幾個月挖掘的隧道逃走。)

meaning:
n. 開關；轉變；交換
v. 切換；轉換；交換
example: A faulty main switch caused the lights to fail, so the entire floor was closed for repairs. (主開關故障導致燈光熄滅，因此整個樓層關閉維修。)

meaning:
n. 許可證；執照
v. 允許；准許
example: The council granted a permit for the music festival despite local objections. (儘管當地居民反對，議會仍核發了音樂節許可證。)

meaning:
v. 進口；引進；意味著
n. 進口品；進口；重要性

The local beekeepers' association meets monthly to discuss hive health, honey prices and upcoming practical winter training courses. (當地養蜂協會每月聚會，討論蜂箱狀況、蜂蜜價格及即將舉辦的冬季實作訓練課程。)
Economists failed to predict the sudden sharp global rise in food prices, which really hit local households hardest. (經濟學家未能預測全球糧價突然大幅上漲，而當地家庭受到的衝擊尤其嚴重。)
The division of the land into small plots caused years of argument. (土地被分割成小塊，引發了多年爭執。)
She finished university with a large debt, so she moved back home and worked two jobs for years. (她大學畢業時背負大筆債務，因此搬回家住，並連續多年做兩份工作。)
A small device worn on the wrist can warn diabetes patients before their blood sugar falls dangerously low. (戴在手腕上的小型裝置，能在糖尿病患者的血糖降至危險低點前發出警告。)
Researchers analyse the water samples in order to identify traces of heavy metals. (研究人員分析水樣本，以找出重金屬的痕跡。)

meaning: n. 受害者；犧牲者；受騙者
example: Scam victims often feel deeply ashamed, so banks now train staff to respond with patience and practical help. (詐騙受害者常感到深深的羞愧，因此銀行現在訓練員工以耐心和實際協助來回應。)

meaning:
n. 委託；佣金；委員會
v. 委託；正式任命；下令製作
example: The artist accepted a commission to paint a portrait of the mayor. (這位藝術家接受委託，為市長繪製肖像畫。)
It amazed me that the tiny shop sold bread from six in the morning. (那家小店從早上六點就開始賣麵包，這讓我很驚訝。)

meaning: n. 結合；組合；密碼鎖號碼
example: The designer chose a bold combination of yellow and blue, making the small shopfront instantly memorable. (設計師大膽搭配黃色與藍色，讓小店面立刻令人印象深刻。)

meaning:
adj. 保守的；守舊的；節制的
n. 保守派人士；保守黨成員
example: Her conservative parents opposed the idea of her travelling alone at night. (她保守的父母反對她夜間獨自旅行。)

meaning:
v. 保證；擔保；確保
n. 保證；保固；擔保品
example: The restaurant cannot guarantee a quiet table by the window, but it will call if one becomes free. (餐廳無法保證能安排靠窗的安靜座位，但有空位時會打電話通知。)

meaning:
n. 等級；排名；階級
v. 排名；列為；分級
example: Hospitals in the region are ranked by how quickly patients are seen in emergencies. (這個地區的醫院依照急診病患接受診療的速度來排名。)
The plan is expensive; nevertheless, most residents agree that the new bridge is necessary. (這項計畫所費不貲；儘管如此，多數居民仍認為興建新橋是必要的。)

meaning:
n. 虐待；濫用；辱罵
v. 虐待；濫用；辱罵
example: The free helpline offers confidential support to victims of abuse, with trained staff available every day around the clock. (免費求助專線為受虐者提供保密協助，並由受過訓練的人員全天候值守。)

meaning:
n. 產量；收益；屈服
v. 產生；讓出；屈服
example: Farmers reported a lower yield this season because the spring rains arrived too late. (農民表示本季產量較低，因為春雨來得太晚。)

meaning:
adj. 安全的；穩固的；有保障的
v. 確保；取得；固定
example: Many older tenants feel less secure because their rents can rise much faster than their pensions, especially in city centres. (許多年長房客覺得較沒有保障，因為房租可能比退休金漲得快得多，市中心尤其如此。)

meaning:
n. 鏈條；連鎖店；一連串
vt. 用鏈條拴住；束縛
example: The supermarket chain plans to open ten new stores in smaller towns. (這家連鎖超市計畫在小型城鎮開設十家新店。)
Speaking in front of the class slowly built her confidence in English. (在全班面前發言，逐漸建立起她使用英文的信心。)

meaning:
n. 框架；窗框；骨架
vt. 裝框；構思；陷害
example: The window frame was rotten, so rain came in during every storm. (窗框已經腐爛，所以每次暴風雨時雨水都會滲進來。)

meaning: n. 身分；身分認同；特徵
example: Identity theft has become far more common, as criminals exploit weak passwords and careless sharing on social media. (犯罪者利用薄弱密碼和社群媒體上不慎分享的資訊，導致身分盜用變得常見許多。)

meaning: v. 負擔得起；提供；抽得出時間
example: Many local fans could not afford the expensive concert tickets, so the band added a free outdoor show for them. (許多當地歌迷買不起昂貴的演唱會門票，因此樂團為他們加辦一場免費戶外演出。)
Rising sea levels threaten low-lying islands and many coastal communities around the world. (海平面上升威脅低窪島嶼和世界各地許多沿海社區。)

meaning:
adj. 道德的；品行端正的；精神上的
n. 寓意；道德教訓
example: The novel raises difficult moral questions about loyalty, honesty and career ambition. (這本小說提出關於忠誠、誠實和事業抱負的艱難道德問題。)
The first phase of the housing project will be completed next summer. (住宅計畫的第一階段預計明年夏天完成。)

meaning: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；通常的
example: A typical weekend in the village involves a market, a football match and a long walk by the river. (在這個村莊，一個典型的週末包括逛市集、看足球賽和沿河長時間散步。)
The committee approved the new reading curriculum, but asked teachers to report fully on its progress every term. (委員會批准了新的閱讀課程，但要求教師每學期完整回報進度。)
Good judgment in traffic often matters more than how fast a car can go. (在交通狀況中，良好的判斷力往往比汽車速度更重要。)
A large proportion of the village now works in the city and comes home only at weekends. (村裡有很大一部分人如今在城市工作，只有週末才回家。)
High concentrations of salt in the soil prevent most crops from growing well. (土壤中的鹽分濃度過高，會妨礙大多數作物生長。)

meaning:
n. 居民；住戶；常駐人員
adj. 居住的；常駐的
example: Local residents complained that the new street lights were far too bright. (當地居民抱怨新設的路燈實在太亮。)

meaning: n. 一段時間；課程；會期
example: The training session lasted two hours and ended with a short quiz. (這場訓練課程持續兩小時，最後以一份簡短測驗作結。)

meaning:
n. 畢業生；研究生
v. 畢業；取得學位；逐步發展
example: Each university graduate receives career advice, and most find full-time work within six months of finishing the course. (每位大學畢業生都會獲得職涯建議，而且多數人在完成學業後六個月內找到全職工作。)

meaning:
n. 許可證；執照；授權
vt. 核發執照；授權
example: Fishermen need a license before they can sell their catch at the market. (漁民必須先取得許可證，才能在市場販售漁獲。)
You need a licence to operate a drone near airports or crowded areas. (在機場或人潮擁擠的地區附近操作無人機，需要取得許可證。)

meaning:
v. 集中；專注；濃縮
n. 濃縮物；濃縮液
example: Heavy traffic is concentrated on two old narrow streets, so the council finally wants to open a bypass. (大量車流集中在兩條狹窄的老街上，因此市議會終於打算興建一條外環道。)

meaning: n. 進入；入口；參賽作品
example: Entry to the museum is free on the first Sunday of each month. (每個月的第一個星期日都可以免費進入博物館。)

meaning: n. 觀念；想法；模糊印象
example: The notion that older workers resist change is not supported by recent surveys. (認為年長員工抗拒改變的觀念，並未獲得近期調查支持。)

meaning: adj. 奇怪的；奇數的；零散的
example: It seemed odd that the shop was closed in the middle of the day. (那家店在白天時段關門，似乎有些奇怪。)

meaning:
adj. 音樂的；有音樂天分的；悅耳的
n. 音樂劇
example: The musical tells the story of a small town that discovers a shared love of music. (這齣音樂劇描述一個小鎮發現居民共同熱愛音樂的故事。)

meaning:
v. 使厭煩；鑽孔；挖洞
n. 令人厭煩的人或事；孔洞
example: Museums easily bore some children, yet interactive exhibits can turn a dull visit into a genuinely memorable afternoon. (博物館很容易讓一些孩子感到無聊，但互動展覽能把乏味的參觀變成真正難忘的午後。)

meaning: adj. 合理的；公道的；適度的
example: It seems reasonable to ask staff to give a week's notice before taking holiday during the busiest season. (要求員工在最忙的季節休假前一週提出通知，似乎很合理。)
Many small farmers rely on seasonal rain rather than expensive irrigation systems. (許多小農依賴季節性降雨，而非昂貴的灌溉系統。)
The teacher asked pupils to arrange the pictures in the correct sequence, then explain the story in their own words. (老師要求學生按正確順序排列圖片，再用自己的話說明故事。)

meaning: adj. 相當大的；可觀的；重要的
example: The storm caused considerable damage to roofs along the whole eastern coast. (暴風雨對整個東岸沿線的屋頂造成相當大的損害。)

meaning:
n. 燃料；刺激因素
v. 給……添加燃料；助長
example: Rising fuel costs have made long-distance commuting far less attractive for most workers. (燃料成本上漲，讓大多數工作者覺得長途通勤吸引力大幅降低。)
The atmosphere in the small room was tense, although everyone still tried to speak politely. (小房間裡的氣氛很緊張，儘管大家仍努力保持禮貌交談。)

meaning: adj. 實用的；實際的；可行的
example: The course is practical rather than theoretical, so students spend most mornings repairing real engines in the workshop. (這門課重視實作而非理論，因此學生大多數早上都在工坊修理真正的引擎。)
His presentation to the client went well, despite his obvious nerves in the opening minutes. (他向客戶做的簡報相當順利，儘管開頭幾分鐘明顯有些緊張。)
No prior experience is required, but all applicants must speak fluent Spanish. (不需要具備先前經驗，但所有申請者都必須能流利地說西班牙語。)

meaning:
n. 山峰；尖峰；巔峰
v. 達到高峰；達到頂點
example: Snow still covers the highest peak even in the middle of summer. (即使在盛夏，最高的山峰仍覆蓋著積雪。)

meaning: n. 機制；機械裝置；程序
example: The report recommends a clear mechanism for handling complaints about noise from factories. (報告建議建立明確機制，處理工廠噪音相關的申訴。)

meaning:
adj. 本地的；土生土長的；母語的
n. 當地人；土著；母語使用者
example: Native speakers often use everyday expressions that textbooks completely ignore, so learners truly benefit from real conversations. (母語人士常使用課本完全未提及的日常用語，因此學習者確實能從真實對話中受益。)

meaning:
v. 投射；投擲；選角
n. 演員陣容；石膏；投擲
example: Tall trees cast long shadows across the quiet road in the evening. (傍晚時，高大的樹木在寧靜的道路上投下長長的影子。)

meaning: n. 人們；民間人士；家人
example: Older folk in the village still remember when the river froze over every single winter. (村裡的長輩仍記得以前那條河每年冬天都會結冰。)

meaning: n. 智力；情報；情報蒐集
example: Dolphins show remarkable intelligence, solving unfamiliar puzzles and even cooperating with one another far more readily than expected. (海豚展現驚人的智力，能解開陌生謎題，彼此合作也比預期容易得多。)
Please write your name at the top of the answer sheet before you begin. (開始作答前，請在答案卷上方寫下姓名。)
The journey from the city to the coast takes about three hours by train. (從市區到海岸搭火車大約需要三小時。)

meaning: adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；極嚴重的
example: The road accident had terrible long-term consequences for the family and the entire community. (這起車禍對那個家庭和整個社區造成嚴重的長期影響。)

meaning:
adj. 多個的；多重的；複合的
n. 倍數；公倍數
example: The patient suffered multiple serious injuries but is now in a stable condition. (這名病人多處重傷，但目前狀況穩定。)
The mayor declared the old riverside market a protected site last spring. (市長去年春天宣布將舊河岸市場列為保護區。)

meaning: adj. 心理的；精神的；智力的
example: Farmers often ignore their own mental health, partly because isolation makes it hard to ask for help. (農民常忽略自己的心理健康，部分原因是孤立使他們難以開口求助。)
To her great relief, the missing keys were in her coat pocket. (令她大大鬆了一口氣的是，不見的鑰匙就在外套口袋裡。)
The professor has spent twenty years studying the effects of urban noise. (這位教授花了二十年研究都市噪音的影響。)
The dog has a gentle personality, making it a popular choice for first-time owners with small children. (這隻狗個性溫和，因此很受有幼童的新手飼主歡迎。)

meaning:
vt. 建造；構築；組成
n. 構想；建構概念
example: Engineers constructed a small dam across the shallow stream, creating a quiet pond for wildlife and summer irrigation. (工程師在淺溪上建了一座小水壩，形成平靜的池塘，供野生動物棲息和夏季灌溉使用。)

meaning:
vt. 捕捉；捕獲；記錄
n. 捕獲；擷取
example: The camera captured a rare bird in mid-flight, giving researchers valuable evidence of its feeding habits. (相機捕捉到一隻飛行中的稀有鳥類，為研究人員提供其覓食習慣的珍貴證據。)
The families waited twenty years for justice after the factory poisoned their river. (工廠污染了他們的河流後，這些家庭等了二十年才盼到正義伸張。)

meaning:
adj. 持續的；不斷的；固定的
n. 常數；恆量
example: Constant short interruptions make it hard for nurses to concentrate, so the ward now has a quiet hour. (不斷出現的短暫打擾讓護理師難以專心，因此病房現在安排了一小時的安靜時段。)
The film exceeded expectations and earned far more than its production cost. (這部電影超出預期，票房收入遠高於製作成本。)

meaning:
n. 目擊者；證人
v. 目擊；見證；證明
example: A witness described the lorry as it turned into the narrow street. (一名目擊者描述了那輛貨車轉進狹窄街道時的情況。)

meaning:
n. 榮譽；敬意；信用
v. 表揚；尊重；履行
example: The school held a special ceremony to honour the teachers who retired that year. (學校舉辦特別典禮，表揚當年退休的教師。)
Doctors can now share electronic records between clinics, which reduces the need for patients to repeat the same tests. (醫師現在能在不同診所間共享電子病歷，減少病人重複接受相同檢查的需要。)

meaning: n. 經銷商；交易商；發牌員
example: The local dealer repaired the water pump and supplied the missing parts. (當地經銷商修好了水泵，並提供缺少的零件。)
The band released their first disc in 1998 and sold thousands of copies. (這個樂團在一九九八年發行首張唱片，並售出數千張。)

meaning:
adj. 化學的；化學作用的
n. 化學物質；化學藥品
example: The factory agreed to reduce chemical waste discharged into the nearby river. (這家工廠同意減少排入附近河流的化學廢棄物。)
The architect's vision for affordable housing impressed the panel, although the budget remains far from secure. (建築師對平價住宅的構想讓評審印象深刻，儘管預算仍遠未確定。)
The city plans to impose a small tax on single-use plastic bags. (市政府計畫對一次性塑膠袋徵收少量稅金。)

meaning:
vt. 預訂；保留；儲備
n. 儲備；保留；自然保護區
example: We reserved seats by the window, but the train company quietly changed the carriage at the last minute. (我們預訂了靠窗座位，但鐵路公司在最後一刻悄悄更換了車廂。)

meaning:
n. 最低限度；最小值
adj. 最低的；最小的
example: The hotel asks for a minimum stay of two nights in August. (這家飯店規定八月至少要住宿兩晚。)
There is wide variation in class sizes across the district, which makes it hard to compare test results fairly. (這個學區各校的班級人數差異很大，因此難以公平比較測驗結果。)

meaning: adj. 正式的；正式場合的；有固定形式的
example: A formal letter is usually better than a text message for job applications. (申請工作時，正式信函通常比簡訊更合適。)
The acquisition of the smaller firm gave the company access to new markets. (收購那家較小的公司，讓該公司得以進入新市場。)
The famous athlete retired at thirty, then successfully started coaching young runners at a small local athletics club. (這位知名運動員三十歲退役，之後成功地在當地一家小型田徑俱樂部開始指導年輕跑者。)

meaning: v. 恢復；復原；重新振作
example: The town gradually recovered after the main factory closed, but new small shops eventually filled the empty streets. (主要工廠關閉後，鎮上逐漸復甦，但後來新開的小店填滿了空蕩的街道。)
The team's mission was to map the caves beneath the limestone hills. (這支隊伍的任務是繪製石灰岩丘陵下方洞穴的地圖。)
She derives great pleasure from daily gardening, which keeps her active and calm after a very long week. (她從每天園藝中獲得很大的樂趣；在漫長的一週後，這讓她保持活力與平靜。)
The food critic praised the soup but complained about the slow service. (美食評論家稱讚了湯品，但抱怨上菜速度太慢。)
Researchers have identified a gene that appears to influence the risk of diabetes. (研究人員已找出一種似乎會影響糖尿病風險的基因。)

meaning:
v. 倚靠；傾斜
adj. 精瘦的；精簡的
example: He leaned against the wall and waited for the bus in the rain. (他倚著牆，在雨中等公車。)

meaning:
v. 瞥一眼；匆匆一看
n. 一瞥；匆匆一看
example: She glanced nervously at her watch and then hurried towards the small crowded meeting room. (她緊張地瞥了一眼手錶，接著趕往那間擁擠的小會議室。)

meaning:
adj. 理想的；完美的
n. 理想；典範
example: The small studio is an ideal place for a writer who needs quiet. (這間小工作室對需要安靜的作家來說是理想的地方。)

meaning: n. 街區；居住區；附近一帶
example: The quiet neighborhood has a small park, a public library and two primary schools. (這個安靜的街區有一座小公園、一間公共圖書館和兩所小學。)
Thousands of students compete nationally for a few university places, so the written entrance test is extremely demanding. (數千名學生在全國各地競爭少數大學名額，因此筆試入學考格外嚴格。)
Doctors warn that this eating disorder often begins quietly, and that early support greatly improves a patient's chance of recovery. (醫師警告，這種飲食失調症往往悄然開始，及早提供支持能大幅提高患者康復的機會。)
The restaurant received a serious complaint about food hygiene, so inspectors visited the kitchen unannounced the following morning. (這家餐廳收到一項嚴重的食品衛生投訴，因此稽查員隔天早上未經通知便前往廚房檢查。)
He writes a weekly column about food and farming for a national newspaper. (他為一家全國性報紙撰寫每週一篇的飲食與農業專欄。)
The course compares how religion shapes modern art, law and everyday customs. (這門課比較宗教如何形塑現代藝術、法律與日常習俗。)
New legislation requires all landlords to install smoke alarms on every floor. (新法規要求所有房東在每一層樓安裝煙霧警報器。)

meaning:
n. 抗議；抗議活動
v. 抗議；反對
example: Thousands of workers joined the protest against the planned closure of the plant. (數千名工人加入抗議活動，反對關閉工廠的計畫。)
The chart illustrates how average temperatures in the city have risen since 1980. (這張圖表說明了自 1980 年以來該市平均氣溫如何上升。)
The public has lost faith in the company after the safety scandal. (安全醜聞發生後，大眾已對這家公司失去信任。)

meaning: n. 觀察；觀察所得；評論
example: Careful observation of the classroom showed that quieter pupils rarely ask for help, even when they are struggling. (仔細觀察教室後發現，較安靜的學生即使遇到困難，也很少開口求助。)

meaning:
v. 命令；指揮；掌握
n. 命令；指揮；掌握能力
example: The officer gave a quiet command, and the soldiers moved forward at once. (軍官低聲下達命令，士兵便立刻向前移動。)

meaning:
vt. 拒絕；否決；排斥
n. 不合格品；遭拒者
example: The council rejected the plan because it would have destroyed a protected wetland. (市議會否決了這項計畫，因為它會摧毀一片受保護的濕地。)
His long silence seemed to imply that he disagreed with the proposal. (他長時間沉默，似乎暗示他不同意這項提案。)

meaning:
vt. 實施；執行；落實
n. 工具；器具
example: The primary school will implement the new reading programme from September onwards. (這所小學將從九月起實施新的閱讀計畫。)
Approximately two hundred people attended the public meeting, though the hall was designed for only half that number. (約有兩百人出席這場公開會議，但會堂原本只按一半的人數設計。)

meaning: v. 取得資格；合格；限定
example: Nurses must qualify before they are allowed to work in public hospitals. (護理師必須先取得資格，才能在公立醫院工作。)
The regional hospital will close its maternity unit next year, forcing expectant mothers to travel to the city. (這家區域醫院明年將關閉產科病房，迫使準媽媽們前往市區就醫。)
The plan was based on the assumption that the river would stay low. (這項計畫是以河水水位會持續偏低這個假設為基礎。)
The closure of the main road will be temporary while workers repair the drain. (工人修理排水溝期間，這條主要道路只會暫時封閉。)

meaning: adj. 有吸引力的；迷人的

meaning: n. 標準；準則；衡量條件

meaning:

meaning:

meaning: adj. 永久的；長期的；固定的

meaning:
n. 塑膠；塑膠卡
adj. 塑膠製的；可塑的；虛假的
example: Much of our ordinary clothing contains hidden plastic, which still sheds tiny fibres every time it is washed. (我們許多日常衣物都含有不易察覺的塑膠纖維，每次清洗時仍會脫落微小纖維。)

meaning:
v. 凝視；仔細看
n. 同儕；同等者；貴族
example: She peered through the fog, trying to find the edge of the road. (她透過濃霧仔細張望，試著找出道路的邊緣。)
Fast broadband has transformed some rural areas, allowing young families to work from home instead of moving away. (高速寬頻改變了一些農村地區，讓年輕家庭能在家工作，不必搬離家鄉。)

meaning:
adj. 相等的；等值的；對等的
n. 對等物；相當物
example: The cost is roughly equivalent to three months of her current salary. (這筆費用大約相當於她目前三個月的薪水。)

meaning: vt. 使複雜；使難以處理
example: A missing stamp on the application form complicated the visa process and delayed our family's departure by a week. (申請表漏蓋一個章，讓簽證程序變得複雜，也使我們全家的出發延後了一週。)

meaning:
v. 倒塌；崩潰；倒閉
n. 倒塌；崩潰；倒閉
example: The sudden collapse of the small airline left thousands of passengers stranded at busy foreign airports for days. (這家小型航空公司突然倒閉，讓數千名旅客在繁忙的海外機場滯留數日。)

meaning: n. 企業；事業；創業精神
example: The social enterprise trains unemployed local adults, selling repaired old bicycles to fund its free practical training courses. (這家社會企業為失業的當地成年人提供訓練，並販售修好的舊腳踏車來支應免費實作課程。)

meaning:
v. 更新；使現代化
n. 最新消息；更新內容
example: The council updates the website every week with news about local road works. (市議會每週都會在網站更新當地道路工程的消息。)
The hospital strictly restricts visiting hours so that elderly patients can rest, but close relatives often still complain. (醫院嚴格限制探病時間，讓年長病患能休息，但親近的家人仍常抱怨。)
The first earthquake damaged several old houses, and subsequent tremors forced residents to sleep outdoors for several long weeks. (第一次地震損壞了幾棟老房子，隨後的餘震又迫使居民在戶外睡了好幾個星期。)

meaning:
vt. 遭遇；遇到；面臨
n. 相遇；遭遇；邂逅
example: Engineers encountered unexpected problems with the new tunnel, which delayed the opening by almost a year. (工程師在新隧道工程中遇到意外問題，導致通車延後將近一年。)

meaning:
n. 碎片；晶片；炸薯條
v. 削去；缺損；削成碎片
example: A small chip of paint fell from the ceiling, and the landlord promised to repair the roof before winter. (一小片油漆從天花板剝落，房東答應在冬天前修理屋頂。)

meaning:
adj. 有價值的；寶貴的；很有用的
n. 貴重物品；財物
example: The failed project taught us a valuable lesson about carefully checking costs before promising a firm delivery date. (這個失敗的專案讓我們學到寶貴的一課：承諾確切交期前要仔細核算成本。)

meaning:
n. 零售；零售業
v. 零售；以零售價出售
example: Retail jobs often involve long evening hours, yet they provide much-needed flexible work for local students and parents. (零售工作常需要長時間上晚班，但也為當地學生和家長提供了迫切需要的彈性工作。)

meaning: n. 情節；陰謀；小塊土地
example: The novel's plot moves quickly and smoothly between wartime Shanghai and modern Taipei. (這本小說的情節在戰時上海和現代台北之間快速而流暢地切換。)
Local groups are working to preserve the old market before developers buy the land. (在開發商買下土地之前，地方團體正努力保存這座老市場。)

meaning:
n. 緊急狀況；突發事件
adj. 緊急的；應急的
example: The council opened a shelter during the emergency, offering hot meals and beds to families whose homes were flooded. (緊急狀況期間，市議會開設了收容所，為家園遭水淹的家庭提供熱食和床位。)

meaning:
n. 安慰；慰藉；舒適
v. 安慰；使寬心
example: She found comfort in the letters her friends sent during that difficult year. (在那艱難的一年裡，她從朋友寄來的信中獲得慰藉。)
The young team deserved victory after such a brave performance, yet they lost on a single last-minute penalty. (這支年輕球隊表現得如此勇敢，原本值得贏得勝利，卻在最後一刻因一記十二碼球落敗。)

meaning: adj. 嚴重的；嚴峻的；嚴厲的
example: Had the drought been less severe, the local village wells would probably still hold enough water for everyone. (如果旱災沒那麼嚴重，當地村莊的水井大概仍會有足夠的水供所有人使用。)
She received public recognition for her patient research after years of quiet effort. (多年默默努力後，她堅持不懈的研究終於獲得公眾肯定。)

meaning: adj. 次要的；中等教育的；第二級的
example: Cost was a secondary concern; safety came first in every single decision. (成本只是次要考量；每一項決定都以安全為先。)

meaning:
n. 證明；證據；校樣
adj. 防……的；耐……的
example: The bank asked for clear proof of address, but her old utility bill was already out of date. (銀行要求提供明確的住址證明，但她的舊水電帳單早已過期。)

meaning: adj. 有能力的；能幹的；可能的
example: She is more than capable of managing the project without any outside help. (她完全有能力在沒有外援的情況下管理這個專案。)

meaning:
vt. 概述；列出要點；勾勒
n. 大綱；概要；輪廓
example: The first paragraph clearly outlines the main argument of the whole essay. (第一段清楚概述了整篇文章的主要論點。)
The seaside town suffered during the long depression, when visitors stopped coming and nearly all family hotels closed. (這座海濱小鎮在長期經濟蕭條期間遭受重創，遊客不再到訪，幾乎所有家族經營的旅館都關門了。)
The committee will evaluate each proposal before deciding where to spend the money. (委員會會先評估每一項提案，再決定資金用途。)

meaning: n. 退休金；養老金；年金
example: His pension is small, so he still works two days a week. (他的退休金不多，所以他每週仍工作兩天。)

meaning: adj. 外部的；外來的；表面的
example: An external examiner carefully reviewed the results, ensuring that strict marking standards remained consistent across all school classes. (一位外部考官仔細審查了成績，確保全校各班都維持一致的嚴格評分標準。)
Rural primary schools often cope with increasingly tight budgets by successfully sharing specialist staff with nearby local institutions. (鄉村小學常藉由與附近機構順利共享專業人員，來應付日益吃緊的預算。)

meaning: n. 強調；重點；著重之處
example: The course places great emphasis on speaking and listening rather than grammar rules. (這門課非常重視口說和聽力，而不是文法規則。)
The new restriction on hand luggage has slowed airport security checks, though passengers admit the queues feel safer. (新的手提行李限制讓機場安檢變慢，但旅客也承認排隊受檢讓人感到更安全。)

meaning: adj. 巨大的；大量的；大規模的
example: A massive increase in online shopping has forced retailers to rethink their delivery systems. (網路購物大幅成長，迫使零售商重新檢討配送系統。)

meaning:
n. 知識分子；學者
adj. 智力的；理智的；知識分子的
example: The cafe was a favourite meeting place for artists, writers and political intellectuals. (這家咖啡館曾是藝術家、作家和政治知識分子最喜愛的聚會場所。)

meaning: n. 少數；少數群體；少數民族
example: Members of the minority community remain poorly represented in local government, despite forming a fifth of the population. (儘管少數族群占人口的五分之一，他們在地方政府中的代表性仍然不足。)

meaning: n. 革命；重大變革；旋轉
example: The arrival of cheap drones caused a quiet revolution in small-scale farming, although few officials noticed it at first. (廉價無人機的出現為小規模農業帶來一場悄然的革命，儘管一開始很少有官員注意到。)
Researchers must submit their final proposals online by Friday, and late applications will normally not be considered. (研究人員必須在星期五前上網提交最終提案，逾期申請通常不會列入考慮。)
The prospect of working abroad appealed to her more than a higher salary. (到國外工作的可能性，比更高的薪水更吸引她。)

meaning: n. 方程式；等式；因素關係
example: The equation looks simple, but solving it correctly requires careful algebraic working. (這個方程式看起來簡單，但要正確解出來需要仔細進行代數運算。)

meaning: n. 失業；失業狀態；失業率
example: Unemployment among young people rose sharply after the largest local factory closed. (當地最大工廠關閉後，青年失業率急劇上升。)
Early intervention by doctors greatly improved the patient's chances of a full recovery. (醫師及早介入，大幅提高了患者完全康復的機會。)

meaning:
v. 使高興；使愉悅
n. 高興；愉悅；樂事
example: The magician's simple tricks delight young children at every birthday party they attend. (每逢生日派對，魔術師簡單的戲法總能讓年幼的孩子們樂在其中。)
Her illness kept her off work for three weeks and she lost part of her income. (她因病三週無法上班，也因此損失了部分收入。)
Numerous small streams cross the field and make walking rather difficult here. (許多小溪橫越這片田地，使得在此步行相當困難。)
The builders abandoned the whole project when the funding was suddenly withdrawn. (資金突然遭撤回後，建築商放棄了整個專案。)

meaning:
vt. 追查；追蹤；描摹
n. 痕跡；少量；蹤跡
example: Local health workers traced everyone who might have come into contact with the infected traveller. (當地衛生人員追蹤了所有可能接觸過這名感染旅客的人。)

meaning: adj. 至關重要的；關鍵的
example: Early diagnosis is crucial for patients with this type of cancer. (對這類癌症患者而言，早期診斷至關重要。)

meaning:
v. 分開；分裂；分成
n. 分裂；分歧；份額
example: The group split into two teams to search both sides of the valley. (這群人分成兩隊，分頭搜尋山谷兩側。)

meaning: adj. 效率高的；有能力的；節省資源的
example: The young worker is remarkably efficient, simply finishing tasks that once took hours in only half the time. (這位年輕員工效率驚人，能把過去要花數小時的工作只用一半時間就完成。)
A handful of large firms dominate the market for household cleaning products. (少數幾家大型企業主導了家用清潔產品市場。)
The database contains the records of every patient treated at the clinic. (這個資料庫包含在該診所接受治療的每位患者紀錄。)
The flood isolated several remote villages for days, so rescue helicopters delivered food and medical supplies to stranded families. (洪水使幾個偏遠村莊與外界隔絕數日，因此救援直升機把食物和醫療物資送給受困家庭。)

meaning:
n. 爭端；爭議；糾紛
v. 對……提出異議；爭論
example: The dispute over pay lasted six months before both sides finally agreed to accept an independent arbitrator's decision. (薪資爭議持續了六個月，雙方最後才同意接受獨立仲裁人的裁決。)

meaning:
n. 地形；景觀；局勢
vt. 美化庭園；設計景觀
example: Wind farms have changed the landscape of this coastal region within a decade. (風力發電場在十年內改變了這個沿海地區的景觀。)
The two plans differ, but they ultimately aim at the same thing. (這兩項計畫雖然不同，但最終目標相同。)

meaning: n. 現象；非凡的人或事
example: This phenomenon is common in large cities, where artificial light and late shifts keep millions of people awake. (這種現象在大城市很常見，因為人造光和晚班讓數百萬人保持清醒。)

meaning:
n. 簡介；側面輪廓；形象
vt. 概述；描繪；寫人物特寫
example: Her online profile had clearly exaggerated her experience, which embarrassed her when colleagues quietly pointed out several errors. (她的線上簡介明顯誇大了自己的經歷，同事私下指出幾處錯誤時，她感到很尷尬。)

meaning: n. 娛樂；娛樂活動；表演
example: Streaming services have entirely changed modern entertainment, allowing viewers to watch almost whatever they like whenever they want. (串流服務徹底改變了現代娛樂，讓觀眾幾乎可以隨時觀看自己想看的內容。)
Older passengers can ask a member of staff for assistance at the gate. (年長乘客可以在登機門請工作人員提供協助。)
A low stone wall clearly marks the boundary between the two farms. (一道矮石牆清楚標示出兩座農場的分界。)

meaning: n. 性別；性別認同；語法性
example: The report found a clear gender pay gap, although the company insists that its hiring process is fair. (報告發現明顯的性別薪資差距，儘管該公司堅稱招聘流程公平。)

meaning: adj. 巨大的；顯著的；戲劇性的
example: The patient made a dramatic improvement, and senior doctors began discussing early discharge. (病人的狀況大幅好轉，資深醫師開始討論讓他提早出院。)
Her academic achievement improved after she joined a small study group, although she still finds maths rather difficult. (加入小型讀書會後，她的學業表現有所進步，不過她仍覺得數學頗為困難。)

meaning: n. 專家；專科醫師；專業人員
example: The specialist explained the treatment in simple language, which reassured the patient far more than the leaflets did. (專家用簡單的語言說明治療方式，讓病人比閱讀傳單後安心許多。)
The serious baby formula shortage worried parents, so shops strictly limited how many tins each customer could buy. (嬰兒配方奶嚴重短缺讓家長很擔心，因此商店嚴格限制每位顧客能買的罐數。)
Investment in research often leads to innovation that benefits the whole economy. (對研究的投資往往會帶來創新，使整體經濟受益。)

meaning: n. 報導；涵蓋範圍；保險承保
example: The flood received little national coverage because another disaster filled the news. (由於另一場災難佔據新聞版面，這場洪水很少獲得全國媒體報導。)

meaning: n. 營業額；人員流動率；周轉
example: The shop's turnover doubled after it started selling coffee in the mornings. (這家店開始在早上賣咖啡後，營業額增加了一倍。)

meaning:
adj. 輕微的；稍微的；瘦小的
vt. 冷落；怠慢；輕視
n. 冷落；怠慢；侮辱
example: A slight rise in temperature can often signal infection, so nurses carefully check patients every four hours. (體溫稍微上升往往可能是感染的訊號，因此護理師每四小時仔細檢查病人。)

meaning:
v. 尖叫；大聲喊叫
n. 尖叫聲；呼喊聲
example: A sudden scream came from the roller coaster, mixing fear with delight. (雲霄飛車上突然傳來一聲尖叫，恐懼與興奮交織在一起。)
The old warehouse was converted into apartments with high ceilings and large windows. (這座舊倉庫被改建成天花板挑高、窗戶寬大的公寓。)

meaning:
n. 未成年人；輔修科目
adj. 較小的；輕微的；次要的
example: He suffered only minor injuries and was released from hospital the same day. (他只受了輕傷，當天就出院了。)

meaning: v. 協商；談判；順利通過
example: Union leaders will negotiate with management over pay and working hours next week. (工會領袖下週將與管理階層協商薪資和工時。)
Industrial pollution has seriously damaged the river for decades, although recent clean-up efforts are finally showing clear results. (數十年來，工業污染嚴重破壞了這條河流，不過最近的清理行動終於顯現出明確成果。)
The era of printed railway timetables is quietly ending, as even small stations now direct passengers to apps. (紙本鐵路時刻表的時代正悄然結束，現在連小車站也引導乘客使用應用程式。)
The company paid a small dividend to shareholders even in a bad year. (即使在景氣不佳的一年，公司仍向股東發放少量股息。)

meaning:
n. 志工；自願者
v. 自願；自告奮勇
adj. 志願的；自願提供的
example: Hospital volunteers regularly read to elderly patients, which often brightens long afternoons for people with very few visitors. (醫院志工定期為年長患者朗讀，常為探訪者寥寥無幾的人們帶來午後的慰藉。)
Washing your hands regularly reduces the risk of infection during the winter months. (冬季期間定期洗手能降低感染風險。)
Careful preparation before the monsoon season saves lives in villages built on low ground. (在季風季節到來前仔細準備，能拯救地勢低窪村莊的居民性命。)

meaning:
vt. 使難過；使心煩；打亂
adj. 難過的；心煩意亂的；不舒服的
example: The news upset her far more than she was willing to admit. (這個消息讓她難過的程度，遠超過她願意承認的程度。)
The transition from school to work can be difficult for young people. (從學校步入職場的過渡期對年輕人來說可能很艱難。)

meaning:
n. 預報；預測
v. 預報；預測
example: The forecast promised a dry week, so farmers rushed to harvest the wheat before the rain finally returned. (預報說接下來一週都會乾燥，因此農民趕在雨勢終於再度來臨前收割小麥。)
The new filters eliminate almost all dust from the air inside the factory. (新的濾網能去除工廠室內空氣中幾乎所有的灰塵。)

meaning: n. 議程；待辦事項；隱藏動機
example: Climate change topped the agenda at the summit, although several poorer nations argued that debt relief mattered more. (氣候變遷是這場高峰會的首要議題，但幾個較貧窮的國家主張債務減免更為重要。)

meaning:
n. 裂縫；裂痕；爆裂聲
v. 破裂；裂開；破解
example: A crack in the dam wall was noticed by a worker during a routine check. (一名工人在例行檢查時，注意到水壩牆上有一道裂縫。)

meaning: adj. 明顯的；表面上的；看似如此的
example: The apparent similarity between the twins hides very different personalities, as their new teachers quickly discovered. (這對雙胞胎表面上的相似，掩蓋了兩人截然不同的性格；新老師很快就發現了這點。)
Private cars are banned from the pedestrian zone between ten and six. (上午十點至下午六點期間，行人徒步區禁止私人汽車進入。)
A fault in the signal system caused delays across the whole line. (號誌系統的一處故障造成整條路線延誤。)
The mountain landscape inspired her first novel, which unexpectedly became a bestseller across Europe. (山間景色啟發了她的第一部小說，而這部作品意外地暢銷整個歐洲。)
The charity spends most of its money on the welfare of older residents. (這個慈善機構將大部分經費用於年長居民的福祉。)
Many drivers still perceive cycling as dangerous, even on quiet side streets. (即使在安靜的巷道上，許多駕駛人仍認為騎自行車很危險。)

meaning: n. 限制；約束；制約因素
example: Lack of time and money are the two main constraints on the research team. (時間和資金不足是研究團隊面臨的兩項主要限制。)
On behalf of the whole village, she thanked the rescue team warmly. (她代表全村，熱切地向救援隊致謝。)

meaning:
n. 固體；立體；可靠的人
adj. 堅固的；牢靠的；實心的
example: The bridge rests on solid foundations that were built deep into the rock. (這座橋建在深入岩層的堅固地基上。)
The rapid expansion of the town has swallowed most of the orchards. (城鎮迅速擴張，吞噬了大部分果園。)

meaning: adv. 幾乎；實際上；虛擬地
example: Virtually all the flats in the new block have already been sold. (新建大樓裡幾乎所有的公寓都已經售出。)
Long daily exposure to loud noise damages hearing, yet many factory workers still refuse to wear proper protection. (每天長時間暴露在巨大噪音中會損害聽力，但許多工廠工人仍拒絕佩戴適當的防護用品。)
The council altered its original plans after residents raised concerns about traffic. (居民提出對交通的疑慮後，市議會修改了原先的計畫。)
She poured the steaming hot soup carefully into four deep bowls, then carried them slowly to the table. (她小心地把冒著熱氣的湯倒進四個深碗裡，接著慢慢端到桌上。)

meaning: n. 船員；機組人員；工作團隊

meaning:

meaning: v. 證明……合理；為……辯護；使有正當理由

meaning:

meaning:

example: The traditional craft of making paper umbrellas survives in a few local families, though tourists rarely buy them. (製作紙傘的傳統工藝在幾個當地家庭中留存下來，不過遊客很少購買。)

meaning: adj. 強烈的；劇烈的；緊張的；熱切的
example: The heat was so intense that the road surface began to soften. (熱度強烈到路面開始變軟。)
The argument sounds convincing, but its logic breaks down under close examination. (這個論點聽起來有說服力，但仔細檢視後其邏輯就站不住腳。)
He finally confronted his fear of public speaking, joining a small local club that meets every Tuesday evening. (他終於面對公開演講的恐懼，加入一個每週二晚上聚會的小型地方社團。)
A sudden drop in sales is an indication that the product needs redesigning. (銷售突然下滑顯示產品需要重新設計。)

meaning: n. 標題；頭條新聞；標題新聞
example: The story became a headline in every newspaper in the region. (這則新聞成了該地區每份報紙的頭條。)
The train was presumably delayed by the heavy fog, since no announcement was made at the crowded platform. (火車大概是因為濃霧誤點，因為擁擠的月台上沒有任何廣播。)

meaning:
adj. 內部的；室內的；國內的
n. 內部；室內；內陸地區
example: The hotel's interior design blends dark wood with soft lighting, creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere. (飯店的室內設計將深色木材和柔和燈光融合在一起，營造溫暖、友善的氣氛。)

meaning:
adj. 具體的；確實的；混凝土製的
n. 混凝土；水泥混合物
example: The police need concrete evidence before charging anyone, not just vague rumours spread by local neighbours. (警方起訴任何人前需要確鑿證據，不能只憑當地鄰居散布的模糊謠言。)

meaning:
adj. 高級的；優質的；額外收費的
n. 額外費用；保險費；溢價
example: The premium ticket includes a hot meal, but most passengers decide it is not worth the extra cost. (高級票包含一份熱餐，但多數乘客認為不值得多付這筆錢。)

meaning:
n. 避難所；遮蔽處；庇護
v. 庇護；躲避；遮擋
example: The bus shelter offered little protection from the midday sun, so passengers stood under a large nearby tree. (公車候車亭幾乎擋不住正午烈日，因此乘客改站在附近一棵大樹下。)

meaning: n. 指引；準則；指導方針
example: The safety guidelines are clear and simple, yet several workers still routinely ignore them when senior supervisors are absent. (安全指引清楚簡單，但幾名工人仍常在資深主管不在時照樣漠視。)
The merger of the two banks led to hundreds of job losses. (兩家銀行的合併導致數百人失業。)

meaning: n. 所有權；擁有；所有人身分
example: Ownership of the disputed land was finally transferred to the local community in 1998. (這塊爭議土地的所有權終於在一九九八年移轉給當地社區。)

meaning: v. 祝福；保佑；使有幸擁有
example: The old priest blessed the newly married couple before they left the church. (老神父在這對新婚夫妻離開教堂前為他們祝福。)

meaning:
v. 緊握；抓牢；吸引；使震撼
n. 緊握；握力；把手；控制
example: He gripped the rail tightly as the boat rocked in the wind. (船在風中搖晃時，他緊緊握住欄杆。)

meaning:
adj. 地下的；秘密的；地下組織的
n. 地下；地鐵（英）；地下組織
adv. 在地下；往地下
example: The underground river slowly flows beneath the whole city, finally emerging near the old stone harbour bridge. (地下河緩緩流經整座城市底下，最後在老石港橋附近湧出地面。)

meaning: n. 基礎設施；基礎建設；基礎架構
example: The small island's infrastructure cannot support a large hospital, so serious cases are quickly flown to the mainland. (這座小島的基礎設施無法支撐大型醫院，因此重症病患會迅速被空運到大陸。)

meaning: n. 接待；接收；接待處；反應
example: Radio reception is clearer at night, so many drivers often listen to their favourite stations during long journeys. (夜間廣播收訊較清楚，因此許多駕駛在長途旅程中常收聽自己喜歡的電台。)

meaning: adj. 嚴格的；嚴謹的；精確的
example: The school has strict rules about mobile phones during lessons and examinations. (學校對上課和考試期間使用手機有嚴格規定。)
Closer cooperation between bus and rail companies would let passengers buy a single ticket for the whole journey. (公車與鐵路公司更密切的合作，能讓乘客用一張票搭完整段旅程。)

meaning: adj. 有機的；有機栽培的；自然形成的
example: The city now collects organic food waste separately and turns it into compost for parks and community gardens. (市政府現在分開回收有機廚餘，並將其製成公園和社區花園用的堆肥。)
I reckon the journey will normally take four hours, provided we avoid the roadworks near the old bridge. (我估計這趟路通常要四小時，只要我們避開老橋附近的道路施工。)

meaning:
n. 代表；代表團成員
vt. 委派；授權；委託
example: Delegates from more than thirty countries attended the climate conference in Geneva. (來自三十多個國家的代表出席日內瓦的氣候會議。)

meaning: adv. 不管；不顧；無論如何
example: The old bridge will be repaired regardless of cost, because the nearest alternative route is forty miles away. (這座老橋將不計成本修復，因為最近的替代路線在四十英里外。)

meaning: n. 景點；吸引力；吸引人的事物
example: The old lighthouse is the main attraction for visitors to this coast. (這座老燈塔是這片海岸最吸引遊客的景點。)
The young athlete trains twice a day and still finds time to study. (這位年輕運動員每天練兩次，還能抽出時間讀書。)
The small fishing boats return to the harbour at dawn with their catch. (小漁船在黎明時帶著漁獲返回港口。)

meaning:
v. 攪拌；攪動；激起
n. 攪動；騷動；轟動
example: Stir the soup gently so that the vegetables do not break apart. (輕輕攪動湯，以免蔬菜散開。)

meaning:
n. 濾器；濾網；濾鏡
v. 過濾；篩選；滲入；逐漸傳開
example: The water filter removes most impurities, yet unfortunately it cannot improve the strange taste of the old pipes. (這台濾水器能去除大部分雜質，但可惜無法改善老舊水管造成的怪味。)

meaning: adj. 浪漫的；愛情的；不切實際的
example: They chose a small restaurant by the river for their romantic anniversary dinner. (他們選了河邊一家小餐廳，度過浪漫的結婚紀念日晚餐。)

meaning:
adj. 柔軟的；溫柔的；疼痛的；嫩的
v. 提出；正式提供；投標
example: Slow cooking makes even cheap cuts of meat tender enough to pull apart easily. (慢火燉煮能讓便宜的肉塊也變得軟嫩，輕易就能撕開。)
The transportation of heavy goods by rail is generally much cheaper than road haulage over very long distances. (鐵路運輸重型貨物通常比公路貨運在極長距離上便宜得多。)
A large cargo vessel slowly entered the harbour at dawn, carrying parts for the new offshore wind farm. (一艘大型貨船在黎明時緩緩進港，載著新離岸風場的零件。)

meaning:
n. 斜坡；坡度；傾斜面
v. 傾斜；成斜坡；逐漸傾向
example: The old house stands on a gentle slope facing the morning sun. (這棟老房子位在朝向晨光的緩坡上。)

meaning: n. 目錄；商品目錄；清單
example: The museum catalogue lists every object in the collection with a short description. (博物館目錄列出館藏中的每件物品，並附簡短說明。)

meaning: n. 出席；出席人數；到場
example: Attendance at local matches has risen sharply since the club lowered ticket prices for families with young children. (自從球團調降帶幼童家庭的票價後，地方賽事的出席人數便上升了。)

meaning: n. 懷孕；妊娠；含義深長
example: Regular gentle exercise during pregnancy often improves sleep, yet doctors advise women to avoid serious exhaustion and overheating. (懷孕期間規律的溫和運動常能改善睡眠，但醫師建議女性避免過度疲累和過熱。)
Nobody knows who first invented the wheel, but it changed human history. (沒有人知道誰先發明了輪子，但它改變了人類歷史。)

meaning: adj. 有爭議的；引起論戰的
example: The council's decision to close the old town market proved highly controversial. (市議會關閉老城市場的決定引發極大爭議。)

meaning: n. 經濟衰退；不景氣；後退
example: During the recession, many families cut spending on travel and eating out. (經濟衰退期間，許多家庭削減旅遊和外食支出。)

meaning: n. 不確定；不確定因素；疑慮
example: Uncertainty about the future makes careful planning very hard, so the team deliberately set several flexible targets instead. (對未來的不確定讓仔細規劃非常困難，因此團隊刻意改設幾個彈性目標。)

meaning: n. 小說；虛構；杜撰的事
example: The library keeps modern fiction on the ground floor, where older readers can comfortably browse a wide selection. (圖書館把現代小說放在一樓，讓年長讀者能舒適地瀏覽豐富的藏書。)

meaning:
v. 暗示；示意
n. 暗示；線索；提示
example: He gave a slight hint that the answer might be in the second paragraph. (他略微暗示答案可能在第二段。)
The amount of paperwork nearly overwhelmed him during his first week at work. (他上班的第一週，堆積如山的文書幾乎讓他不知所措。)

meaning: adj. 焦慮的；擔心的；渴望的
example: Parents grow increasingly anxious when children miss curfew, even if the delay usually has a perfectly harmless explanation. (孩子超過門禁時間時，父母會越來越焦慮，即使延誤通常有完全無害的解釋。)

meaning:
n. 攻擊；襲擊；猛烈抨擊
v. 襲擊；攻擊；猛烈抨擊
example: The campaign aims to reduce assaults on public transport staff late at night. (這項活動旨在減少深夜對大眾運輸員工的襲擊事件。)

meaning:
n. 跳躍；劇增；飛躍
v. 跳躍；猛衝；欣然接受機會
example: She leaped at the rare chance to study abroad, even though it meant leaving her secure well-paid job. (她欣然抓住難得的出國留學機會，即使這意味著要辭掉穩定且高薪的工作。)

meaning:
n. 回聲；附和；重現
v. 發出回聲；附和；呼應
example: The echo of the announcement could be heard across the empty hall. (公告的回聲在空蕩蕩的大廳裡都聽得見。)

meaning:
n. 陰涼處；遮陽物；色調；細微差異
v. 遮蔽；使變暗；略微改變色調
example: Planting trees along this street provides shade and lowers summer temperatures considerably. (沿著這條街種樹可以提供陰涼，並大幅降低夏季氣溫。)

meaning: n. 肖像；人物描寫；生動刻畫
example: The portrait shows an elderly farmer standing in front of his stone house. (這幅肖像畫描繪一位年長的農夫站在他的石屋前。)

meaning:
n. 鉤子；掛鉤；吸引人的事物
v. 鉤住；掛起；吸引住
example: A rusty hook above the door still held the old heavy lantern that guided weary visitors at night. (門上方一個生鏽的掛鉤仍掛著那盞沉重的舊燈籠，過去它在夜裡為疲憊的訪客指路。)

meaning: adj. 住宅的；居住的；供住宿的
example: The new factory was built too close to a quiet residential area. (新工廠蓋得離安靜的住宅區太近了。)

meaning: n. 資格；資歷；限制條件
example: A teaching qualification is not enough on its own; new staff also need months of supervised classroom practice. (光有教師資格還不夠；新進教職員還需要數個月受督導的課堂實習。)
The injury damaged a nerve in his hand, leaving two fingers numb. (這次受傷損害了他手上的一條神經，導致兩根手指麻木。)
He bought a sturdy leather bag that should last for many years. (他買了一個結實的皮革包，應該可以用很多年。)

meaning:
n. 廢氣；排氣裝置
v. 耗盡；使筋疲力盡；詳盡論述
example: The long journey quickly exhausted our small food supply, so we stopped at the next village. (漫長的旅程很快耗盡了我們不多的食物，所以我們在下一個村莊停下來。)

meaning:
n. 碎片；片段；殘篇
v. 使破碎；分裂成片段
example: Archaeologists found small fragments of ancient pottery buried beneath the barley field. (考古學家在大麥田下方發現古代陶器的小碎片。)

meaning: v. 漫遊；閒逛；心不在焉地走動
example: We wandered through the narrow old streets and discovered a tiny bookshop. (我們在狹窄的老街上閒逛，發現了一間小書店。)
The leaders agreed to unite their efforts against the spread of the disease. (各國領導人同意團結一致，共同對抗疾病蔓延。)

meaning: n. 穀物；穀粒；細微顆粒
example: Whole grain bread contains more fibre than bread made from white flour. (全穀麵包的纖維含量比白麵粉做的麵包高。)
The departure of the chief engineer left the project without clear leadership. (總工程師的離開，讓專案缺乏明確的領導。)

meaning: n. 帝國；大型企業集團；勢力範圍
example: He built a business empire from one small shop, yet his children have little interest in running it. (他從一家小店建立起商業帝國，但他的孩子對經營它興趣缺缺。)

meaning:
n. 奢侈品；奢華；難得的享受
adj. 奢華的；高級的
example: A quiet hotel room is a rare luxury in this busy resort, especially during the long summer holidays. (在這座熱鬧的度假勝地，安靜的飯店房間是難得的享受，尤其是在漫長的暑假期間。)

meaning: n. 喜劇；喜劇作品；滑稽場面
example: The comedy at the small local theatre was clever, although a few jokes depended on very specific references. (這家小型地方劇院的喜劇很巧妙，不過有幾個笑點依賴非常特定的典故。)
There was some confusion about which entrance we were supposed to use. (大家對於該走哪個入口有些困惑。)

meaning: v. 消耗；消費；食用；使著迷
example: These older machines in the factory consume far more electricity than modern models do. (工廠裡這些老舊機器消耗的電力遠比現代機型多。)
